pillars.note: The Saffire-I-specific objective is flame spread and growth (paper, p. 4; DoD para 1). The low-g flammability-limit objective is stated for the SAFFIRE series (first sentence of DoD para 1), not for Saffire-I alone; it is the prevention pillar. Pillar is the curator's classification and the weakest one here: the reviewer should decide.
